description: CORRECTIV publishes groundwater monitoring summaries and trends for Germany from 1990 through 2021. The repository README describes monthly aggregation of observations from about 6,700 wells in 13 federal states, quality checks for level jumps and a 32-year trend test. Its CSV files expose station metadata, trend measures and low-water summaries that a modeller can use as historical context. Geographic coverage is Germany but excludes places whose monthly series failed the stated completeness threshold. GitHub metadata states GPL-3.0 terms for the repository; original state-agency observation terms may need separate review. A limitation is that wells have different depths and sampling frequency, so a trend is not a uniform aquifer-volume change. The data can help check groundwater stress scenarios for drinking-water or agricultural infrastructure. The related catalogue ERA5 record provides atmospheric conditions, not groundwater measurements. No CSV or raw monitoring data was downloaded.
name: CORRECTIV Germany monthly groundwater analysis
notes: G7 G7-1675. Prepared draft only. Metadata review on 2026-09-28; no models, data or archives downloaded. Related-resource comparisons are reviewer mappings, not tested interoperability. The code/repository licence is GPL-3.0; terms of original state-agency groundwater observations were not independently checked.
schema_summary: Monthly station groundwater levels and derived low-water and trend summaries
